description: This file defines an abstract class 'DatabaseAbstract' for handling database-like data operations within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine. It includes methods for evaluating, filtering, extracting fields, building queries, and processing conditions on database data represented as arrays.

classes.name: DatabaseAbstract
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods for database-like data querying, filtering, and evaluation in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Abstract method to evaluate a database expression based on given database, field, and criteria.

methods.name: fieldExtract
methods.description: Extracts the column index from a database based on the field label or position.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters the database rows based on specified criteria.

methods.name: getFilteredColumn
methods.description: Returns data of a specific column from the filtered database.

methods.name: buildQuery
methods.description: Constructs a query string based on criteria labels and conditions.

methods.name: buildCondition
methods.description: Builds a condition string for criteria with potential wildcard processing.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Executes the constructed query against the database and filters matching rows.

methods.name: processCondition
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in conditions with actual data values during query execution.
